info.title: Campus-Auth Web API
info.description: Baseline OpenAPI document for Campus-Auth. Generated as a static snapshot to enable `npm run typegen`. NOTE: handlers are not yet annotated with utoipa derive macros; this file is a manual baseline and should be regenerated from #[derive(utoipa::OpenApi)] once that integration lands. The hand-written frontend/src/api/types.ts remains the source of truth until then.
